title: Short-term hiring timed to funded courses
theme: How might an employer and a provider align hiring and course cohorts so that grant support, rather than the job, drives the hire?

messages.text: Simulated: would you run cohorts timed to our short-term hires so their course falls inside the contract period?
Simulated: role offered for the course period; extension not expected.

contributions.description: Hires people on short contracts timed to a funded course and releases them after completion.
contributions.benefit_to_self: Grant-supported headcount at low net cost.

contributions.description: Nominates the new hires for the funded course.
contributions.benefit_to_self: Eligibility for course and wage support.

contributions.description: Sponsors the course fee, which is largely offset by subsidy.
Claims fee subsidy and any wage support for the hires.

flows.description: Fee subsidy and wage support claimed for the hires.
Short contract covering the course period.

assumptions.text: Wage support is available to the employer while a hire attends training; not stated in sources.

messages.text: Simulated: would schedule cohorts around your hiring dates.

contributions.description: Runs cohorts timed to the employer's hiring cycle and records delivery.

assumptions.text: The provider knows the hires are temporary; it could equally be unaware.

messages.text: Simulated: would take the short role for the wage and certificate.

contributions.description: Attends and confirms attendance in a role expected to end after the course.

assumptions.text: The trainee may not know the role is temporary.

assumption_findings.note: Wage support is not described in the annexes; confirm scheme rules before testing.
Provider knowledge is unknown; essential does not mean complicit.

review.mo_rationale: Matches MO-06: people hired only to attend a course and let go afterwards. No Annex B excerpt relates to this pattern.

test_data_needed.data_item: Employment start and end dates relative to course dates
test_data_needed.purpose: Detect contracts that start and end with a funded course

test_data_needed.data_item: Employer retention rate after course completion
Share of an employer's training claims from staff with tenure under three months

concerns: Provider is functionally essential but may be unwitting; avoid treating it as a co-conspirator without data.
